entities.summary: Edmund Glaise von Horstenau, also known as Edmund Glaise-Horstenau was an Austrian Nazi politician who became the last vice-chancellor of Austria, appointed by Chancellor Kurt Schuschnigg under pressure from Adolf Hitler, shortly before the 1938 Anschluss.
